PancakeSwap is a decentralized exchange that enables token swaps without intermediaries. PancakeSwap operates on the BNB Smart Chain. PancakeSwap uses liquidity pools to facilitate trading. PancakeSwap uses its CAKE token for rewards and governance.

HegicStaking is a staking contract for HEGIC tokens. HegicStaking is linked to the Hegic options protocol on Ethereum. HegicStaking distributes fees to users who stake HEGIC tokens.

Fuse is a permissionless lending platform for creating money markets. Fuse is built on smart contracts that run on public blockchains.
